external_benchmark: HaluEval Calibration and Expected Calibration Error (ECE) Studies

our_baseline_result.source: Adapted from PIE codified runs and test_runner outputs

external_limits: ECE 0.08 raw to 0.009 calibrated; overconfidence on hallucinations; domain shifts (~18% base in general); post-hoc only (after generation); length/format biases (HaluEval experiments)
comparison: Our applicability requires citations (which would improve calibration per external). Coherency/PIE would address root uncertainty causing overconfidence. Grandmas-wisdom proxy aligns with ECE mitigation. DAER prunes volatile overconfident branches pre-generation. Our gate 'fails' raw high-confidence claims until evidenced - directly addressing the external limit of post-generation detection and miscalibration.
insight: 1:1 shows our methods meet the calibration challenge by moving detection and evidence upstream (pre-gates + provenance), rather than relying on post-hoc fixes. The 'fail' on raw is the feature that prevents the overconfidence the external documents.
provenance: Generated for 1:1 external/internal comparison per user directive. Cite external first (HaluEval arXiv + ECE papers), associate to grandmas-wisdom/PIE/DAER, run test_runner for gate comparison.
